moves.name: Pangil sa Likuran
notes: upstreamNotes: 2-hit boomerang projectile (can only hit once on the way up, then applies all remaining hits on the way back); button strength determines projectile distance (LP short / MP mid / HP far); the listed active frames are for the L/M/H versions respectively; projectile disappears if Yasmine is hit; can only have one boomerang on-screen at a time; only the first 3 active frames are Super cancelable; the initial upward hit keeps opponents grounded (less range vs. crouching opponents); the returning projectile puts opponents into a limited juggle state; canceling from 2HP gives increased hit advantage (use LP boomerang from point blank 2HP for a link into 2LP in the corner); projectile speed refers to the initial activation before changing directions
ユーザー指定: 強度未指定の採用済み基本必殺技の共通値をL/M/Hのゲーム用代表値へ展開。実性能一致を保証せず、ODは生成しない。
